description: Canonical list of roles used across the architecture model, as artefact audience and author, and (later) for login, access control, and tailored UI. Grouped by category. Names are validated against config/schemas/roles.json. Drawn from TOGAF/ArchiMate stakeholder vocabulary and the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

roles.name: Enterprise Architect
roles.description: Owns the enterprise-wide architecture vision, principles, and roadmap across all domains.

roles.name: Business Architect
roles.description: Owns business capabilities, processes, and the operating model.

roles.name: Data Architect
roles.description: Owns data domains, models, and governance.

roles.name: Application Architect
roles.description: Owns the application landscape, platforms, and application standards.

roles.name: Integration Architect
roles.description: Owns interfaces, APIs, events, and integration patterns.

roles.name: Solution Architect
roles.description: Owns end-to-end solution designs spanning multiple domains for a specific initiative.

roles.name: Security Architect
roles.description: Owns security architecture, controls, and assurance.

roles.name: Infrastructure Architect
roles.description: Owns infrastructure, hosting, networks, and the technology architecture (TOGAF Phase D).

roles.name: Technical Architect
roles.description: Owns low-level technical design and implementation standards for a delivery team.

roles.name: Business Analyst
roles.description: Elicits and documents business requirements and processes.

roles.name: Process Analyst
roles.description: Models and analyses business processes and operational flows.

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.description: Analyses data to produce insight and validate data models.

roles.name: Systems Analyst
roles.description: Bridges business requirements and system/application design.

roles.name: Product Manager
roles.description: Owns the product vision, roadmap, and value (SAFe Product Management).

roles.name: Product Owner
roles.description: Owns the team backlog and accepts work (SAFe Product Owner).

roles.name: Epic Owner
roles.description: Shepherds significant initiatives through the portfolio (SAFe Epic Owner).

roles.name: Programme Director
roles.description: Accountable for delivery of a programme of work and its outcomes.

roles.name: Delivery Manager
roles.description: Manages delivery, dependencies, and team health.

roles.name: Release Train Engineer
roles.description: Facilitates the Agile Release Train and programme execution (SAFe RTE).

roles.name: Engineering Lead
roles.description: Leads an engineering team and its technical practices.

roles.name: Architecture Review Board
roles.description: Governs architecture decisions, principles, and exceptions (TOGAF Architecture Board).

roles.name: Chief Information Officer
roles.description: Executive accountable for information technology and systems.

roles.name: Chief Technology Officer
roles.description: Executive accountable for technology strategy and engineering.

roles.name: Chief Data Officer
roles.description: Executive accountable for data strategy, governance, and value.

roles.name: Chief Information Security Officer
roles.description: Executive accountable for information security and risk.

roles.name: Chief Operating Officer
roles.description: Executive accountable for business operations.

roles.name: Chief Digital Officer
roles.description: Executive accountable for digital strategy and transformation.
